owner: AppStore/film (Claude session). The website session reads this file and doesn’t edit it.
revision: system-font cut, after Jun’s review: “Feels too much labels. Remove resume play. Don’t use serif. Paper texture like the app dune theme, apple esque, system font.”
summary: The 45-second film is now on the app’s own paper grain, in the system font and the app’s dune palette, with the technical furniture removed. Each moment leads with the genuine app UI on Apple’s Duo model, one headline and a line or two of copy. The app icon, provider icons, Pro tags, account and manga disclosures and credits stay.

source.paper: src/paper.js (port of the app’s paper stock)
source.score: tools/music.py (comments only; the audio is unchanged)

type.family: Apple system font: SF Pro Display for headlines (semibold) and copy (regular), SF Pro Text for small text, Hiragino Sans for Japanese. No Baskerville, Mincho or monospaced labels remain.

paper.scale: 256 px tile for 128 pt, drawn one tile pixel per film pixel (as on a 2× display).
paper.card: #FFFCF6 card stock, rounded, with a soft warm shadow instead of a rule

palette.dune_use: Honbako Pro capsules, the reader’s chat bubble (white text), taps, the AI’s mark on the page and its leader.

removed: Running head (HONBAKO 本箱) and section numbers/names
Device dimension lines and leaders (84.1 / 117.8 / 164.6 mm, INNER DISPLAY, IPHONE DUO)
Small caps feature labels (LOCAL FILES, MCP SERVER, ROMAJI, …) and IN YOUR AI APP / ANNOTATED BY YOUR AI
The vermilion 本箱 seal (it was a Mincho editorial mark)
kept: Canonical app icon on the title and end cards
ChatGPT, Claude and Grok App Store icons, with “Names and icons belong to their owners. Honbako isn’t affiliated with them.”
Honbako Pro tags: Japanese reading help, Duo cover display, Remote MCP for cloud AI apps
End card: “Some features require Honbako Pro. Compatible AI-provider account required.”
Footnotes: AI-provider account separate and requests sync while open; Honbako doesn’t provide manga; cover display camera use
“Illustrative demonstration” on the AI chat cards
Manga credit on every frame that shows it and on the end card
Genuine captures and recordings on Apple’s Duo model
applied.resume_widget: The genuine Resume widget capture stays, including its own ▶ Resume button, which is app UI. Jun’s “remove resume play” was about the website’s playback button; the film has none.

render.rebuild: npm run render && npm run poster && npm run storyboard (previews: ffmpeg at 2.5 Mb/s from the masters)

recoverable.branded_editorial_cut: src/brand-aligned/ (film.js, index.html, shots.json, its film-brand-aligned.json) and renders/brand-aligned/
recoverable.how: Copy a backup’s film.js and index.html over src/ and run npm run render. (The branded cut needs no paper.js.)

remaining_conflicts.state: Neutral “Your AI” mark, not a provider icon.
remaining_conflicts.why: The chat text was written for the film; a provider logo would suggest that provider wrote it.

remaining_conflicts.state: ブラックジャックによろしく by 佐藤秀峰, credited. Website and shared demos use only the original sample story.
remaining_conflicts.why: User decision for the film. Don’t reuse film frames on the website.

remaining_conflicts.state: Unchanged; “Designed for iPhone Duo.” is still the user’s call.

not_done: No changes to the app, the website or App Store Connect; Apple review stays on hold.
The score was not re-rendered and hasn’t been auditioned by ear.
